words: I tried making do with the laptop screen on the kitchen table: school emails, recipe tabs and the family photo albums I'm sorting all open at once. Altogether I've 43500 US cents to spend - that's the whole lot, not a cent more in the pot. Every item on the list should be ready and waiting for me - none of them missing from the shelf. Right so - here's the list, and there's a few bits to it. First, 1 portable monitor in silver. Then 2 home soundbars, speakers or subwoofers - the connectivity on them is 3-pin XLR and the woofer size is at least 12 inches. And last, 2 streaming media players running Android 14 with at least 2 GB of RAM. Get the total down as far as it'll go. The home soundbars, speakers & subwoofers needs to be one that suits the chosen portable monitors. The streaming media players needs to be one that suits the chosen portable monitors. It was like weeding a bed through a keyhole. I'll only receive 3 messages from you - anything after that is turned away. We've 99 steps - then we're finished - done or not. A silver one beside it would be grand.

You get 3 listings per call, and you choose the row offset to start from.; itemOpen(listingNumber): Opens up a single listing so you can look at it.; stashToBasket(entries): Sets the trolley contents. Whatever you send replaces the whole trolley with those lines, and you get the whole trolley back.; userSay(words): Sends a note to the user.; listingsLocate(freeQ, listFirst): Searches through listings and hands back 3 rows per call.
